name: project-context-system
displayName: project-context-system — agent context that stays true
description: Turns any project into a self-maintaining markdown knowledge base (Karpathy-style LLM wiki: raw sources, wiki pages, schema) so coding agents read a compiled, interlinked wiki instead of re-exploring the codebase every session. Ships AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md, memory.md handoff, a routed context/ folder (index, log, architecture, codebase map, module pages, specs, decisions, tracker, data model, API contracts, glossary, runbook) and a zero-dependency ctx CLI (init, brief, impact, stale, lint, doctor, index, coverage, log, stamp, new, status, hook) plus hooks that block a session that changed code without updating the pages that describe it.
